pages.title: Synthetic Station
pages.extract: The Synthetic Station (/ˈsɪnθɛtɪk/; Testish: Stantsiya) is a made-up orbital station   used only in tests. It has four modules. It was assembled by two made-up agencies. It is not a real spacecraft.

pages.title: Testnet
pages.extract: Testnet is a made-up navigation constellation used in tests. It has twelve satellites.
